<reason>PRO won by neutralizing CON's two live routes while keeping its own. Fixed-supply distinction blunted the bread price-control analogy, and trust-concentration plus app-lock showed a platform cap could starve scalpers where volume lives. CON's redundancy-or-unenforceable dilemma was answered as feasibility-not-redundancy, and CON never answered platform conflict-of-interest or how surge pricing protects the nurse.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO's fixed-supply plus guaranteed-channel response in Rebuttal 1: caps need not make seats, only decide nurse vs server farm, and buyers prefer in-app guaranteed face-value over risky DMs.</best_rebuttal>
